'''Tom Sailor Drain n' Capture''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Tom Sailor]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds127.htm Drain n' Capture], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010119090100/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds127.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
